tool.name: ETE3 Setup Taxonomy Database
tool.description: build an ETE3 NCBI taxonomy SQLite database
tool.command:
#if $taxonomy_source.source == 'existing': #set $taxonomy_dir = $taxonomy_source.taxdump.fields.path python '$__tool_directory__/build_ete3_taxonomy.py' --output-db taxa.sqlite --taxonomy-dir '$taxonomy_dir' && #else: python '$__tool_directory__/build_ete3_taxonomy.py' --output-db taxa.sqlite && #end if
python '$__tool_directory__/make_json.py' --output '$out_file' --path taxa.sqlite --value ncbi_taxonomy --name 'NCBI Taxonomy'

param.name: source
param.label: NCBI taxonomy source
param.option: Use an installed NCBI taxonomy dump

param.name: taxdump
param.label: NCBI taxonomy database
param.help: NCBI taxonomy data installed through the NCBI taxonomy Data Manager

validator.message: No NCBI Taxonomy database download is available

tool.help:
**What it does**
Builds an ETE3 SQLite taxonomy database from NCBI taxonomy data.
The database can either be created from an NCBI taxonomy dump already installed in Galaxy through the NCBI taxonomy Data Manager, or ETE3 can download the current NCBI taxonomy directly.
The resulting SQLite database is registered in the ``ete3_taxonomy_db`` tool data table and can be reused by Galaxy tools that depend on an ETE3 NCBI taxonomy database.
-----
**Inputs**
- **Existing NCBI taxonomy dump**: uses taxonomy data already installed in Galaxy through the ``ncbi_taxonomy`` tool data table. - **Download current NCBI taxonomy**: downloads the current taxonomy directly and constructs the ETE3 SQLite database.
